0022600024.text: The Denver Nuggets (2-2, on a one-game winning streak, 9th in the West and 1.5 games back in the Northwest) visit the Phoenix Suns (1-2, on a one-game losing streak, 11th in the West and 2 games back in the Pacific) as of today. Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (personal), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Denver won all three meetings in 2025-26, including a 125-123 win in Phoenix on March 24, 2026.
